ModMetaData.name: ISEKAI — No Auto Camera Jump [Star Sky Mods]
ModMetaData.author: chupakobra6 | Star Sky Mods
ModMetaData.description: Keep your camera where you left it when a local ISEKAI hunt spawns its target. FEATURES • Stops the forced camera jump for ordinary local ISEKAI hunts and hunt packs from ISEKAI CREATURES (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3757560461). • Keeps letters, messages and clickable target links, so you can jump to the target when you choose. • Leaves regular RimWorld camera jumps, world bosses, hero visits and Guild duels unchanged. HOW TO USE RimWorld’s Mod Settings has separate switches for ordinary hunts and creature hunt packs. Both are enabled by default. Changes apply immediately and are saved in RimWorld’s configuration. COMPATIBILITY Requires RimWorld 1.6, Harmony (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2009463077) and ISEKAI RPG LEVELING (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3657580708). Load after these dependencies and any Guild/Creatures add-ons. English and Russian interface text is included. ISEKAI CREATURES is optional; its switch applies only when that add-on is installed. Can be added to an existing save; back up before removal. Original ISEKAI files are neither included nor modified. FEEDBACK Found a bug or an inaccuracy? Leave a comment on the mod page or on Boosty.
